# Reach v2.7.2 - Table of Contents

> Program dependence graph for Elixir, Erlang, Gleam, JavaScript, and TypeScript

## Modules

- [Reach.AST](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.AST.md): Shared helpers for working with Elixir AST.
- [Reach.Analysis](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Analysis.md): Shared analysis helpers for project-wide queries.
- [Reach.CallGraph](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CallGraph.md): Builds call graph edges between function definitions.
- [Reach.Concurrency](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Concurrency.md): Detects concurrency patterns (Task, spawn, GenServer calls).
- [Reach.Config](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Config.md): Parses and normalizes .reach.exs architecture policy configuration.
- [Reach.DependencySummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.DependencySummary.md): Summarizes function dependencies (callers, callees, shared state).
- [Reach.Graph](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Graph.md): Adjacency-list graph data structure with vertex and edge operations.
- [Reach.GraphAlgorithms](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.GraphAlgorithms.md): Graph traversal algorithms (BFS, DFS, reachability, SCC).
- [Reach.HigherOrder](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.HigherOrder.md): Resolves higher-order function references to concrete callees.
- [Reach.IR.Counter](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.IR.Counter.md): Monotonic ID counter for IR node construction.
- [Reach.Source](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Source.md): Helpers for attaching source-origin metadata to lowered AST.
- [Reach.Source.Origin](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Source.Origin.md): Origin metadata for AST lowered from framework or template syntax.
- [Reach.Source.Span](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Source.Span.md): Source span metadata used by lowered plugin AST and Reach IR nodes.

- Public API
  - [Reach](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.md): Program Dependence Graph for Elixir and Erlang.
  - [Reach.MacroFact](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.MacroFact.md): Source-level facts for macro and DSL declarations.
  - [Reach.Project](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Project.md): Multi-file project analysis.

- CLI Commands
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Check](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Check.md): Runs structural validation and change-safety checks.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Inspect](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Inspect.md): Explains one function, module, file, or line.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Map](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Map.md): Shows a project-level map of modules, coupling, hotspots, depth, effects,
boundaries, and data-flow summaries.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.OTP](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.OTP.md): Shows GenServer state machines, missing message handlers, and hidden coupling.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.OTP.Concurrency](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.OTP.Concurrency.md): Concurrency patterns — Task.async/await pairing, process monitors,
spawn_link chains, and supervisor topology.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Report](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Report.md): Analyze code with Reach and generate an interactive dependency graph.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace.md): Traces data flow, taint paths, and forward/backward slices.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace.Flow](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace.Flow.md): Traces data flow from sources to sinks. Detects taint paths where
untrusted input reaches dangerous operations.
  - [Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace.Slice](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.CLI.Commands.Trace.Slice.md): Program slicing — finds the minimum set of statements that affect a value.

- Project Queries
  - [Reach.Project.Query](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Project.Query.md): Query API for filtering and searching project nodes and edges.

- Inspect
  - [Reach.Inspect.Candidates](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Candidates.md): Finds advisory graph-backed refactoring candidates for one target function.

  - [Reach.Inspect.Context](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Context.md): Builds agent-readable context bundles for a single target function.

  - [Reach.Inspect.Data](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Data.md): Builds target-local data-flow summaries for `mix reach.inspect`.

  - [Reach.Inspect.Data.EdgeSummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Data.EdgeSummary.md): Struct for a cross-function data flow edge summary.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Data.NodeSummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Data.NodeSummary.md): Struct for a data flow node summary.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Data.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Data.Result.md): Struct for data inspection results.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Data.VariableSummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Data.VariableSummary.md): Struct for a variable flow summary.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Deps](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Deps.md): Builds dependency summaries for one target function.

  - [Reach.Inspect.Impact](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Impact.md): Builds impact summaries for a target function.

  - [Reach.Inspect.Why](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Why.md): Finds and explains relationship paths between two targets.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Why.Path](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Why.Path.md): Struct for a single relationship path with evidence.
  - [Reach.Inspect.Why.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Inspect.Why.Result.md): Struct for why-path query results.

- Map
  - [Reach.Map.Analysis](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Analysis.md): Computes project-wide summaries including modules, hotspots, coupling, effects, depth, and data flow.
  - [Reach.Map.Boundary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Boundary.md): Struct for functions with multiple distinct side-effect kinds.
  - [Reach.Map.Coupling](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Coupling.md): Struct for module coupling metrics including afferent, efferent, and instability.
  - [Reach.Map.Cycle](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Cycle.md): Struct for a module dependency cycle with its components.
  - [Reach.Map.DataFunction](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.DataFunction.md): Struct for a function with cross-function data flow edges.
  - [Reach.Map.DataSummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.DataSummary.md): Struct for a cross-function data flow summary.
  - [Reach.Map.DepthMetric](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.DepthMetric.md): Struct for control nesting depth metrics of a function.
  - [Reach.Map.EffectCall](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.EffectCall.md): Struct for a call site with its classified effect.
  - [Reach.Map.EffectRow](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.EffectRow.md): Struct for a per-function effect classification row.
  - [Reach.Map.EffectSummary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.EffectSummary.md): Struct for project-wide effect distribution.
  - [Reach.Map.Hotspot](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Hotspot.md): Struct for complexity × callers hotspot metrics.
  - [Reach.Map.ModuleCoupling](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.ModuleCoupling.md): Struct for per-module coupling detail.
  - [Reach.Map.ModuleMetric](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.ModuleMetric.md): Struct for per-module complexity metrics.
  - [Reach.Map.Summary](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.Summary.md): Struct for project-level summary statistics.
  - [Reach.Map.UnknownCall](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.UnknownCall.md): Struct for a call with unresolved effect classification.
  - [Reach.Map.XrefEdge](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Map.XrefEdge.md): Struct for a cross-function reference edge.

- Trace
  - [Reach.Trace.Flow](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Flow.md): Taint and variable flow tracing through data dependence edges.
  - [Reach.Trace.Flow.Path](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Flow.Path.md): Struct for a single taint flow path.
  - [Reach.Trace.Flow.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Flow.Result.md): Struct for flow trace results.
  - [Reach.Trace.Pattern](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Pattern.md): Plugin-dispatched trace pattern presets.
  - [Reach.Trace.Slice](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Slice.md): Backward and forward program slicing from a source location.
  - [Reach.Trace.Slice.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Slice.Result.md): Struct for program slice results.
  - [Reach.Trace.Slice.Statement](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Trace.Slice.Statement.md): Struct for a single statement in a program slice.

- Check
  - [Reach.Check.Architecture](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Architecture.md): Validates `.reach.exs` architecture policies against project structure.
  - [Reach.Check.Candidate](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Candidate.md): Struct for an advisory refactoring candidate with confidence and proof.
  - [Reach.Check.Candidates](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Candidates.md): Generates graph-backed refactoring candidates from cycles, effects, and pure regions.
  - [Reach.Check.Changed](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Changed.md): Analyzes changed functions for risk, impact, and clone siblings.
  - [Reach.Check.Changed.Function](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Changed.Function.md): Struct for a changed function with risk metadata.
  - [Reach.Check.Changed.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Changed.Result.md): Struct for changed-code analysis results.
  - [Reach.Check.DeadCode](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.DeadCode.md): Finds dead code — pure expressions whose values are never used.

  - [Reach.Check.DeadCode.Finding](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.DeadCode.Finding.md): Struct for a dead code finding.
  - [Reach.Check.Smells](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Smells.md): Runs structural and performance smell checks over a loaded project.

  - [Reach.Check.Violation](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Check.Violation.md): Struct for an architecture policy violation.

- Smells
  - [Reach.Smell.Check](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Check.md): Behaviour and shared helpers for IR-based smell checks.
  - [Reach.Smell.Check.AST](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Check.AST.md): Shared behaviour for smell checks that scan source files with Sourceror AST.
  - [Reach.Smell.Check.Source](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Check.Source.md): Macro DSL for source-backed smell checks.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.AppendInRecursion](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.AppendInRecursion.md): Detects ++ [item] in recursive tail calls where prepend + reverse would be O(n) instead of O(n²).
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.BareRescue](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.BareRescue.md): Detects rescue clauses that catch every exception type.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.BehaviourCandidate](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.BehaviourCandidate.md): Detects module groups sharing the same public callback set.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.CloneConsistency](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.CloneConsistency.md): Detects structural drift across clone families.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.CollectionIdioms](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.CollectionIdioms.md): Pattern-based detection of suboptimal collection operations.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.ConfigPhase](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.ConfigPhase.md): Detects compile-time/runtime config phase mismatches.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.ConversionIdioms](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.ConversionIdioms.md): Detects unnecessary conversion idioms such as one-shot tuple access and identity float coercion.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.DualKeyAccess](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.DualKeyAccess.md): Detects mixed atom/string key access on the same map.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.ETSPartialKeyMatch](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.ETSPartialKeyMatch.md): Detects ETS wildcard matches over versioned tuple keys that may return arbitrary rows.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.FalseSuccessError](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.FalseSuccessError.md): Detects validation/check functions that turn error tuples into success-like values.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.FixedShapeMap](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.FixedShapeMap.md): Detects repeated map literals that should be structs.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.IdiomMismatch](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.IdiomMismatch.md): Detects non-idiomatic patterns such as guard equality and update-then-fetch.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.LoopAntipattern](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.LoopAntipattern.md): Detects O(n²) patterns in loops and recursive functions.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.MissingExternalResource](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.MissingExternalResource.md): Detects compile-time file reads without matching @external_resource declarations.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.MultipleEnumAt](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.MultipleEnumAt.md): Detects multiple Enum.at/2 calls on the same variable with literal indices.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.NestedEnum](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.NestedEnum.md): Detects Enum.member? nested inside another Enum traversal of the same variable.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.PipelineWaste](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.PipelineWaste.md): Pattern-based detection of redundant pipeline operations.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.RedundantAssignment](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.RedundantAssignment.md): Detects variables assigned then immediately returned as the last expression.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.RedundantComputation](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.RedundantComputation.md): Detects duplicate pure calls within the same function.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.RepeatedTraversal](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.RepeatedTraversal.md): Detects repeated Enum traversals on the same variable.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.StandardLibraryBypass](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.StandardLibraryBypass.md): Detects ad-hoc implementations that bypass standard library helpers.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.StringBuilding](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.StringBuilding.md): Detects string concatenation where iolists are more efficient.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.TrivialDelegate](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.TrivialDelegate.md): Detects pass-through API layers that only forward to another function.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.UnsafeAtom](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.UnsafeAtom.md): Detects dynamic atom creation from non-literal input.
  - [Reach.Smell.Checks.UnsafeBinaryToTerm](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Checks.UnsafeBinaryToTerm.md): Detects unsafe binary_to_term calls without the :safe option.
  - [Reach.Smell.Finding](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Finding.md): Struct for smell check findings with location and evidence.
  - [Reach.Smell.Helpers](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Helpers.md): Shared helpers for smell checks including loop detection, statement pairs, and callbacks.
  - [Reach.Smell.Registry](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Registry.md): Auto-discovers and lists all smell check modules.
  - [Reach.Smell.Suppressions](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Smell.Suppressions.md): Filters smell findings using config and source-level suppressions.

- OTP
  - [Reach.OTP](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.md): Entry point for OTP analysis, covering GenServer, gen_statem, and supervisor patterns.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.md): Analyzes GenServer and gen_statem state machines from IR to extract behaviours, state transforms, and missing handlers.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis.Behaviour](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.Behaviour.md): Struct representing a detected OTP behaviour with its callbacks and state transforms.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis.MissingHandler](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.MissingHandler.md): Struct representing a missing GenServer or gen_statem handler finding.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.Result.md): Struct holding the combined results of an OTP analysis run.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis.StateTransform](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.StateTransform.md): Struct representing a state transformation performed within an OTP callback.
  - [Reach.OTP.Analysis.Supervisor](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Analysis.Supervisor.md): Struct representing extracted supervisor child specifications.
  - [Reach.OTP.Concurrency](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Concurrency.md): Detects concurrency patterns such as tasks, spawns, monitors, and supervisors across project functions.
  - [Reach.OTP.Concurrency.Result](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Concurrency.Result.md): Struct holding the results of a concurrency pattern analysis.
  - [Reach.OTP.Coupling](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.Coupling.md): Detects hidden coupling across modules via shared ETS tables, process dictionary keys, and message patterns.
  - [Reach.OTP.CrossProcess](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.CrossProcess.md): Analyzes cross-process data dependencies by tracing effects through GenServer call/cast boundaries.
  - [Reach.OTP.DeadReply](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.DeadReply.md): Detects GenServer.call sites where the reply value is discarded.
  - [Reach.OTP.GenServer](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.GenServer.md): Extracts GenServer state access patterns, callbacks, and reply semantics from module IR.
  - [Reach.OTP.GenStatem](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.OTP.GenStatem.md): Extracts gen_statem states, transitions, and event handlers from module IR.

- Evidence
  - [Reach.Evidence](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.md): Reusable evidence providers consumed by smells, checks, and refactoring candidates.
  - [Reach.Evidence.AST](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.AST.md): Shared AST helpers for evidence providers.
  - [Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.md): Process-dictionary-cached clone detection dispatcher.
  - [Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.Clone](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.Clone.md): Struct for a clone family (a group of similar code fragments).
  - [Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.ExDNA](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.ExDNA.md): ExDNA-backed clone detection provider.
  - [Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.Fragment](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.CloneAnalysis.Fragment.md): Struct for a single code fragment within a clone family.
  - [Reach.Evidence.Fact](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.Fact.md): A reusable evidence fact emitted by evidence providers.
  - [Reach.Evidence.MapContract](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.MapContract.md): Collects evidence for maps that behave like implicit contracts.
  - [Reach.Evidence.PatternRunner](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.PatternRunner.md): Runs ExAST patterns for evidence providers.
  - [Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.md): Collects evidence of ad-hoc code that bypasses standard library helpers.
  - [Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.Enum](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.Enum.md): Collects Enum standard-library bypass evidence.
  - [Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.Map](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.Map.md): Collects Map standard-library bypass evidence.
  - [Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.PathURI](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Evidence.StandardLibraryBypass.PathURI.md): Collects Path/URI standard-library bypass evidence.

- IR
  - [Reach.IR](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.IR.md): Internal Representation tree utilities.
  - [Reach.IR.Helpers](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.IR.Helpers.md): Utility functions for IR node inspection and traversal.
  - [Reach.IR.Node](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.IR.Node.md): A node in the internal representation.

- Analysis
  - [Reach.ControlDependence](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.ControlDependence.md): Computes control dependence from CFG and post-dominators.
  - [Reach.ControlFlow](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.ControlFlow.md): Translates IR nodes into control flow graph vertices and edges.
  - [Reach.DataDependence](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.DataDependence.md): Computes data dependence (def-use chains) from IR.
  - [Reach.Dominator](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Dominator.md): Immediate dominator/post-dominator trees and dominance frontiers.
  - [Reach.Effects](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Effects.md): Effect classification for IR nodes.
  - [Reach.SystemDependence](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.SystemDependence.md): Builds system dependence graph from per-function PDGs.

- Frontends
  - [Reach.Frontend](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Frontend.md): Registry dispatching source files to language-specific frontends.
  - [Reach.Frontend.BEAM](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Frontend.BEAM.md): BEAM bytecode frontend for analyzing compiled .beam files.
  - [Reach.Frontend.Elixir](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Frontend.Elixir.md): Translates Elixir AST into Reach IR nodes.
  - [Reach.Frontend.Erlang](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Frontend.Erlang.md): Translates Erlang abstract forms into Reach IR nodes.
  - [Reach.Frontend.Gleam](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Frontend.Gleam.md): Gleam source frontend — parses `.gleam` files into Reach IR.

- Visualization
  - [Reach.Visualize](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Visualize.md): Generates interactive HTML reports from project analysis.
  - [Reach.Visualize.ControlFlow](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Visualize.ControlFlow.md): Decomposes CFG into visualization blocks and edges.
  - [Reach.Visualize.Graph.JSON](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Visualize.Graph.JSON.md): Serializes graph data to JSON for frontend rendering.
  - [Reach.Visualize.Helpers](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Visualize.Helpers.md): Shared helpers for source extraction and line mapping.
  - [Reach.Visualize.Source](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Visualize.Source.md): Extracts and highlights source code snippets for blocks.

- Plugins
  - [Reach.Plugin](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugin.md): Behaviour for library-specific analysis plugins.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ash](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ash.md): Plugin for Ash framework action and resource semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.md): Plugin for Ecto query DSL, Repo calls, and schema semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.FloatMoney](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.FloatMoney.md): Detects money-like Ecto fields and columns declared as :float.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.ImplicitCrossJoin](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.ImplicitCrossJoin.md): Detects Ecto queries that use multiple from generators instead of explicit joins.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.InterpolatedSQL](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.InterpolatedSQL.md): Detects string interpolation in Ecto SQL fragments and raw queries.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.RepoAllThenEnum](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.RepoAllThenEnum.md): Detects loading all rows before filtering or aggregating in Elixir.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.RepoCallInLoop](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.RepoCallInLoop.md): Detects Repo calls inside enumerable loops that can cause N+1 queries.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.UnpinnedQueryValue](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Ecto.Smells.UnpinnedQueryValue.md): Detects unpinned local variables in Ecto query comparisons.
  - [Reach.Plugins.ExUnit](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.ExUnit.md): Plugin for ExUnit test-suite semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.ExUnit.Smells.AsyncGlobalState](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.ExUnit.Smells.AsyncGlobalState.md): Detects async ExUnit modules that mutate global process/application state.
  - [Reach.Plugins.GenStage](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.GenStage.md): Plugin for GenStage producer/consumer semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Helpers](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Helpers.md): Shared helpers for plugin callback implementations.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Jason](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Jason.md): Plugin for Jason effect classification and JSON encoder smells.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Jason.Evidence.HandRolledEncoder](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Jason.Evidence.HandRolledEncoder.md): Collects evidence of manual JSON encoding that Jason can own.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Jason.Smells.HandRolledEncoder](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Jason.Smells.HandRolledEncoder.md): Detects hand-rolled JSON encoding that should live behind Jason encoders.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Jido](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Jido.md): Plugin for Jido action, signal, and tool semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.LiveView](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.LiveView.md): Plugin for LiveView and HEEx template semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Oban](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Oban.md): Plugin for Oban worker and job semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Oban.Smells.AtomArgs](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Oban.Smells.AtomArgs.md): Detects Oban perform/1 callbacks that pattern match atom keys in job args.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Oban.Smells.NewArgs](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Oban.Smells.NewArgs.md): Detects non-portable Oban job args at enqueue time.
  - [Reach.Plugins.OpenTelemetry](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.OpenTelemetry.md): Plugin for OpenTelemetry span and context propagation.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.md): Plugin for Phoenix conn, LiveView, and channel semantics.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.AssignAsyncCapturesSocket](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.AssignAsyncCapturesSocket.md): Detects LiveView async callbacks that capture the socket.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.AssignNewRefreshedValue](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.AssignNewRefreshedValue.md): Detects assign_new/3 for assigns that usually need refreshing inside LiveView mount/3.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.DisconnectedMountRepo](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.DisconnectedMountRepo.md): Detects direct Repo work in LiveView mount/3 without a connected?/1 guard.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.PubSubSubscribeWithoutConnected](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.PubSubSubscribeWithoutConnected.md): Detects LiveView mount/3 subscriptions that are not guarded by connected?/1.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.RawHTML](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Phoenix.Smells.RawHTML.md): Detects explicit Phoenix.HTML.raw/1 with dynamic content.
  - [Reach.Plugins.Poison](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.Poison.md): Plugin for Poison effect classification.
  - [Reach.Plugins.QuickBEAM](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.QuickBEAM.md): Plugin for cross-language analysis of QuickBEAM (Elixir + JavaScript).
  - [Reach.Plugins.QuickBEAM.JavaScriptFrontend](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Reach.Plugins.QuickBEAM.JavaScriptFrontend.md): QuickBEAM JavaScript source frontend — parses `.js` files into Reach IR.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix reach](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.md): Generates an interactive HTML report for Elixir/Erlang/Gleam/JavaScript source files.

- [mix reach.otp](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.Otp.md): Shows GenServer state machines, missing message handlers, and hidden coupling.

- Inspect
  - [mix reach.inspect](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.Inspect.md): Explains one function, module, file, or line.

- Map
  - [mix reach.map](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.Map.md): Shows a project-level map of modules, coupling, hotspots, depth, effects, boundaries, and data-flow summaries.

- Trace
  - [mix reach.trace](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.Trace.md): Traces data flow, taint paths, and forward/backward slices.

- Check
  - [mix reach.check](https://reach.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Reach.Check.md): Runs structural validation and change-safety checks.
